name: ai-project-manager
description: Local-first AI project manager that observes projects, plans work, routes tasks to AI agents, humans, or services, verifies outcomes, and escalates only when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Manage projects across AI agents and humans.
interface.longDescription: Observe project evidence, maintain an execution ledger, plan milestones, route work to AI agents, people, or services, verify results, and surface only decisions that need human attention.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $project-orchestrator to inspect the current project, update the execution ledger, advance safe AI work, and show only the human decisions or actions that are currently needed.
